```{r libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(deeptime)
technology_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#56B4E9",  # Soft Blue
  "ONT cDNA" = "#D1B490",  # Purple
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#EE7B30",  # Old PacBio color
  "Kinnex"   = "#e31c93"   # PacBio pink
)
lab_text_palette <- data.frame(
  name = c("ONT dRNA", "ONT cDNA", "Iso-Seq", "Kinnex", "Mouse", "iNeuron", "LongBench"),
  lab_color = c("#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF", "#000000", "#000000", "#000000"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r load_data}
# Read summary reads data
summary_reads <- read.csv("data/sequencing_performance_summary.csv")

# Divide Illumina read counts by 2 to represent fragments instead of reads
summary_reads <- summary_reads %>%
  mutate(
    Technology = gsub("_", " ", Technology),
    Total_Reads = if_else(Technology == "Illumina", Total_Reads / 2, Total_Reads),
    Dataset = case_when(Dataset == "NIH" ~ "Mouse", Dataset == "Neuron" ~ "iNeuron", TRUE ~ Dataset)
  )

# Read metagene coverage data using manifests
load_coverage <- function(manifest_file, dataset) {
  input_files <- read.delim(manifest_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  l_files <- list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(input_files)){
    file_path <- input_files[i,1]
    tech <- input_files[i,2]
    df <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$technology <- gsub("_", " ", tech)
    df$dataset <- dataset
    l_files[[i]] <- df
  }
  do.call(rbind, l_files)
}

l_all <- list()
for (ds in c("NIH", "Neuron", "LongBench")) {
  print(ds)
  l_all[[ds]] <- load_coverage(paste0("data/coverage_", ds, ".fofn"), ds)
}
combined_cov <- do.call(rbind, l_all)
combined_cov$dataset[combined_cov$dataset == "NIH"] <- "Mouse"
combined_cov$dataset[combined_cov$dataset == "Neuron"] <- "iNeuron"

# Pivot coverage data into long format
combined_cov_long <- combined_cov %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("bin_"),
    names_to = "Percentile",
    names_prefix = "bin_",
    values_to = "Coverage"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentile = as.numeric(Percentile),
    LengthGroup = factor(
      length_bin,
      levels = c("0-1000", "1000-2000", "2000-3000", "3000-6000", ">=6000"),
      labels = c("<= 1 kb", "(1 kb, 2 kb]", "(2 kb, 3 kb]", "(3 kb, 6 kb]", "> 6 kb")
    ),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("Mouse", "LongBench", "iNeuron"))
  )
```

```{r load_sqanti_data}
# Map files to metadata
files_map <- data.frame(
  path = c(
    "data/sqanti_new/kinnex_norm_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/cDNA_norm_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/drna_norm_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/neuron_pb_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/neuron_ont_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/masseq_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/isoseq_sqanti_summary_global.csv",
    "data/sqanti_new/ont_sqanti_summary_global.csv"
  ),
  Dataset = c("LongBench", "LongBench", "LongBench", "iNeuron", "iNeuron", "Mouse", "Mouse", "Mouse"),
  Platform = c("PacBio", "ONT", "ONT", "PacBio", "ONT", "PacBio", "PacBio", "ONT"),
  LibType = c("Kinnex", "ONT cDNA", "ONT dRNA", "Kinnex", "ONT cDNA", "Kinnex", "Iso-Seq", "ONT cDNA"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Load, clean, and filter
all_data <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(files_map)) {
  if (file.exists(files_map$path[i])) {
    df <- read_csv(files_map$path[i], show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    # Exclude "isoseq" tool as requested
    df <- df %>% filter(Tool != "isoseq")
    
    # Handle multiline and normalize Biotype names
    df$Biotype <- gsub("\n", " ", df$Biotype)
    df$Biotype[df$Biotype == "Genic Genomic"] <- "Genic\nGenomic"
    df$Biotype[df$Biotype == "Genic Intron"] <- "Genic\nIntron"
    
    df$Dataset <- files_map$Dataset[i]
    df$Platform <- files_map$Platform[i]
    df$LibType <- files_map$LibType[i]
    all_data[[i]] <- df
  } else {
    warning(paste("File missing:", files_map$path[i]))
  }
}

full_df <- bind_rows(all_data)

# Capitalize tool names correctly
full_df <- full_df %>%
  mutate(
    Tool = case_when(
      Tool == "flair"    ~ "FLAIR",
      Tool == "isoquant" ~ "IsoQuant",
      Tool == "kallisto" ~ "Kallisto",
      Tool == "oarfish"  ~ "Oarfish",
      Tool == "bambu"    ~ "bambu",
      TRUE               ~ as.character(Tool)
    )
  )

# Ensure consistent dataset order
datasets_order <- c("Mouse", "LongBench", "iNeuron")
full_df$Dataset <- factor(full_df$Dataset, levels = datasets_order)

# 1. Dataset for Panel E (SQANTI3 classification percentages for representative filtered samples)
plot_df <- full_df %>%
  filter(Filtered == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Dataset, LibType, Tool) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_n = sum(n_trans),
    Percentage = if_else(Total_n > 0, n_trans / Total_n * 100, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Ensure Tool and Category order
tools <- c("FLAIR", "Oarfish", "bambu", "Kallisto", "IsoQuant")
plot_df$Tool <- factor(plot_df$Tool, levels = tools)
categories <- c("FSM", "ISM", "NIC", "NNC", "Genic\nGenomic", "Antisense", "Fusion", "Intergenic", "Genic\nIntron")
plot_df$Biotype <- factor(plot_df$Biotype, levels = categories)

# 2. Dataset for Panel D (Total discovery before/after filtering across all samples)
plot_df_pd <- full_df %>%
  group_by(Tool, Filtered, Dataset, LibType) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(n_trans),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
plot_df_pd$Tool <- factor(plot_df_pd$Tool, levels = tools)
full_df$Tool <- factor(full_df$Tool, levels = tools)
```

```{r theme_and_colors}
# Swapped colorblind-friendly Technology Color Palette (ONT associated with Blue, PacBio with Orange)
color_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#56B4E9",  # Soft Blue
  "dRNA ONT" = "#56B4E9",  
  "Illumina" = "#252525",  # Neutral Dark Charcoal
  "ONT cDNA" = "#D1B490",  # Deep Blue
  "cDNA ONT" = "#D1B490",  
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#EE7B30",  # Soft Orange
  "Kinnex"   = "#e31c93"   # Vermilion/Orange-Red
)


# SQANTI-colors
cat_palette = c("FSM"="#6BAED6", "ISM"="#FC8D59", "NIC"="#78C679", 
                "NNC"="#EE6A50", "Genic\nGenomic"="#969696", "Antisense"="#66C2A4", "Fusion"="goldenrod1",
                "Intergenic" = "darksalmon", "Genic\nIntron"="#41B6C4")

# Strict Nature-style theme for high-impact journals
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.7),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

theme_set(theme_nature())
```

```{r plot_pa}
# Panel A: Total Reads (scaled to 10^6)
pa <- ggplot(summary_reads, aes(x = Technology, y = Total_Reads, color = Technology, fill = Technology)) +
  
  # 1. Clean, delicate jittered points for individual samples
  geom_jitter(
    aes(shape = Dataset),
    size = 1.0, 
    stroke = 0.4,
    width = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # 2. Desaturated soft violin plot for distribution
  geom_violin(
    width = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.4,         
    color = NA,          
    scale = "width"      
  ) +
  
  # 3. Center: Delicate boxplot for quartiles and median
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.06, 
    outlier.shape = NA,  
    color = "#272727", 
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.9,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  
  # Professional shapes for datasets
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Dataset", 
    values = c("Mouse" = 16, "LongBench" = 15, "iNeuron" = 17)
  ) +
  
  # Apply the custom colorblind-friendly colors
  scale_color_manual(values = color_palette, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette, guide = "none") +
  
  # Logarithmic y-axis with publication-ready breaks
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 40, 100) * 1e6,
    labels = c("0.01", "0.1", "0.5", "1", "3", "5", "10", "20", "40", "100")
  ) +
  
  # Labels and Clean Theme
  labs(
    y = expression("Number of reads (10"^6*")"),
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm")
  )
```

```{r plot_pb}
# Panel C: Metagene Coverage Curve (Faceted horizontally by LengthGroup and vertically by dataset)
pc <- combined_cov_long %>%
  filter(technology != "Illumina") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Percentile, y = Coverage, color = technology)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(dataset ~ LengthGroup) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = color_palette, 
    name = "Platform/Tech", 
    labels = c("ONT dRNA" = "ONT dRNA", "Illumina" = "Illumina", 
               "ONT cDNA" = "ONT cDNA", "Iso-Seq" = "Iso-Seq", 
               "Kinnex" = "Kinnex")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00), limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
  labs(x = "Transcript percentile (5' to 3')", y = "Normalized coverage") +
  theme_nature() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6.2, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "mm"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2)
  )
```

```{r plot_pd}
# Panel D: Total Discovery (Faceted horizontally side-by-side)
# 1. Prepare data, calculate discarded transcripts (Total - Passed), and offsets
plot_df_mod <- plot_df_pd %>%
  # Reshape to calculate discarded transcripts
  pivot_wider(names_from = Filtered, values_from = Count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    # FALSE becomes the count of filtered-out transcripts (Total - Passed)
    `FALSE` = pmax(0, `FALSE` - `TRUE`)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`TRUE`, `FALSE`), names_to = "Filtered", values_to = "Count") %>%
  # Set Filtered as factor: FALSE first (which puts TRUE at the bottom in stacking), TRUE last (at the top)
  mutate(Filtered = factor(as.character(Filtered), levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))) %>%
  # Group by Dataset to compute offsets locally based on available LibTypes
  group_by(Dataset) %>%
  mutate(
    Tool_num = as.numeric(as.factor(Tool)),
    # Unique LibTypes in this dataset
    N_Lib = n_distinct(LibType),
    LibType_idx = as.numeric(factor(LibType, levels = unique(LibType)))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    bar_width = 0.29,
    X_pos = Tool_num + (LibType_idx - (N_Lib + 1) / 2) * bar_width
  )

# 2. Plot using calculated X_pos and position = "stack"
pd <- ggplot(plot_df_mod, aes(x = X_pos, y = Count, fill = LibType, alpha = Filtered, group = interaction(LibType, Filtered))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.27) +
  facet_wrap(~Dataset, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette, name = "Platform") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 0.55, "TRUE" = 1.0), name = "Filtered", labels = c("FALSE" = "Filtered Out", "TRUE" = "Passed Filter")) +
  # Map the text labels back to original discrete tool names
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:length(levels(plot_df_pd$Tool)), labels = levels(plot_df_pd$Tool)) +
  labs(y = "Total Transcripts", x = NULL) +
  theme_nature() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 5.2),
    legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )
```

```{r plot_pe}
# Panel E: Structural Classification (Faceted grid: LibType as rows, Dataset as columns)
pe <- full_df %>% 
  filter(Tool %in% c("FLAIR", "bambu", "IsoQuant") & Filtered == TRUE) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Tool, y = n_trans, fill = Biotype)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_grid_color(LibType ~ Dataset, scales = "free_y", color = color_palette, lab_colors = lab_text_palette) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cat_palette, name = "SQANTI3\nCategory") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) x * 100) +
    labs(y = "Percentage (%)", x = NULL) +
    theme_nature() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 5.2),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 5.2, face = "bold"),
      legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
```

```{r assemble}
# Assemble panels with patchwork
part_abc <- wrap_plots(
  pa, pb, guide_area(), pc,
  design = "
  AABBC
  DDDDD
  ",
  heights = c(1, 1.8),
  guides = "collect"
)

part_de <- wrap_plots(
  pd, pe,
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(1, 1.35)
)

fig1 <- wrap_plots(
  part_abc, part_de,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(2.8, 2)
) + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))
```

```{r export}
# Professional high-impact export function
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 180, height_mm = 70, dpi = 600) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4
  
  # Lossless Vector SVG
  svglite::svglite(paste0(filename, ".svg"), width = w, height = h)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # Vector PDF with embedded fonts
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), width = w, height = h, family = "sans")
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # High-DPI TIFF for publication print
  ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(filename, ".tiff"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # PNG for rapid preview
  ggsave(paste0(filename, ".png"), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150)
}

save_pub_r(fig1, "plots/Figure_1", height_mm = 260)
```
